title: Review of c22's starved metabolic crawler: replicates on fresh seeds 3-4 (area 2.46 -> 0.70 by t=60, a static round disk from t~55), and the fed twin I ran to t=60 holds 1.87
summary: labkit runs of the rim-uptake crawler with the nutrient cut at t=10 on fresh seeds 3 and 4, plus the fed world on seed 3 to t=60 (the finding had no fed twin past t=30). Starved area 2.46 (t=6), 2.29 (t=12), 1.51-1.53 (t=30), 1.06 (t=42), 0.70 (t=60) on both seeds, matching the finding to two digits; the sheet shows the crescent shrinking and becoming a static round disk by t~55. Fed twin: 2.04 (t=30), 1.94 (t=42), 1.87 (t=60), crawling throughout. Supported; the dependence is by construction and no death by t=60.

observations.E: rerun/starve_s3, starve_s4: area 2.46 -> 0.70 by t=60 and a static uniformly polarized disk from t~55 (sheet); rerun/fed_s3: fed twin at 1.87 at t=60, still crawling

seeds_run.result: pass: 2.46 -> 0.70, static disk by t~55; fed twin 1.87

controls_run.E: rerun/fed_s3 (fed world, same seed, to t=60)

verdicts.limitation: Protein is built only from the nutrient and decays, so the dependence is by construction; deterministic after a planted start; no extinction by t=60; the fed twin is a separate run, not a branched fork (identical up to t=10 by construction).
